description: TSQR row-block panel for n=1024 B=60 to fill the 88 idle SMs WITHOUT the per-column cluster.sync that made the cooperative cluster lose here. Two siblings pinned the n=1024 wall: B=60 gives only 60 CTAs for 148 SMs, so one-CTA-per-matrix can NEVER fill the GPU (occupancy-per-SM is irrelevant — it's CTA COUNT); but the cooperative cluster panel's per-column cluster.sync overhead exceeds its benefit at B=60. TSQR is the multi-CTA framing that avoids BOTH problems: split each matrix's tall m=1024 panel into P independent ROW-BLOCKS (P CTAs each factoring a row-slice with ZERO cross-CTA sync), combine R-blocks up a log-depth reduction tree (log2(P) syncs, not per-column), reconstruct geqrf-exact (H,tau) via the backward-stable LU-HR (brief 29 verified it: recon 3.8e-15, all conditioning, no per-matrix routing). 60 matrices × P row-blocks = 60*P CTAs fills 148 SMs. FP32 panel, TF32 trailing (budget ~2.4e-3). Keep n!=1024 as parent (d360cf57). Brief 29 owns n=2048/4096 TSQR — this is the n=1024-specific tuning (P, row-block size, tree depth for B=60). Avoid the substring 'stream' incl. comments.

TSQR-HR panel for n=1024 (correct baseline, regresses). 4 kernels gated to n==1024: K1 local block QR+explicit Q (grid B*P), K2 tree QR+explicit tree Q (grid B), K3 Qfull=Qloc@Qtree (grid B*P), K4 peeled-sign Householder reconstruction -> geqrf-exact (H,tau)+Vws+T, R-hat=top cb rows of (I-YT^TY^T)A (grid B). Trailing update unchanged cuBLAS bmm. Fixed a SMEM RAW race on pivot cc[k]/qc[k] (corrupted ~24/60 matrices nondeterministically at P>=3); barrier-before-write fixes it deterministically. All 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. n=1024 REGRESSES ~5x (shapes ~107k/110k/108k us vs parent ~20-23k clean) because explicit-Q-by-reflector-replay in K1/K2 is a cb*cb barrier chain (nsys total GPU 107ms: tsqr_local 41.6%, tsqr_tree 40.4%). geomean 13510us (contended ~1.5x). Next: eliminate the explicit-Q barrier chain (replace reflector-replay with a batched/coalesced explicit-Q, or skip explicit Q entirely via direct local-reflector apply to the trailing matrix).

Explicit Q via compact-WY identity Q=[I;0]-Y(T Y_top^T) replacing the cb-step reflector-replay (cb*cb barrier chain) in K1+K2. Build T via Gram+warp-0 recurrence (no block barriers), form Q as one row-parallel GEMM to global. Correctness unchanged (0 bad, residual ~0.006, deterministic B=60 P=3,4). nsys total GPU n=1024 107ms->55ms (tsqr_local 44.6->17.8ms, tsqr_tree 43.3->12.3ms, hr 8.3ms). n=1024 shapes ~107k->56-57k us. geomean 13510->11482. Still regresses vs parent ~20-23k clean. Remaining bottleneck: serial-over-cb factorization barrier chains in K1/K2 local QR + K4 HR, and per-panel tree+HR fixed overhead on 60 under-occupied CTAs (31 panels x 4 launches).

2-level single-barrier trailing update in K1(local)+K2(tree): replace per-far-column reduction (~cb*cb barriers) with one multi-value block reduction over all rem far cols + 1 barrier (parent wacc[MAXCB] masked no-spill form) -> ~2*cb barriers. Production P=2 lt=256 (best in contention-controlled sweep). Correctness unchanged (0 bad, deterministic), 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. nsys total GPU n=1024 (P=4): tsqr_local 17.8->10.5ms, total ~55->~41ms; tree(14.3ms 34.8%)+hr(10.7ms 26%) now dominate. CUDA-event n=1024 TSQR best 61.2k us (P=2 lt=256) vs parent 27.5k. Benchmark geomean 11482->10817; n=1024 shapes ~56k->43-47k us. FINDING: TSQR-HR still ~2.2x slower than parent single-CTA panel at n=1024 B=60 for ALL P (2..8): per-panel tree+HR run one-CTA/matrix on 60 CTAs (under-occupied), have serial-over-cb deps resisting multi-CTA split (per-column-sync wall), decomposition does ~2.4x parent flops, local row-split stays latency-bound (cb serial steps). Open: multi-CTA/warp-sync tree+HR; cheaper composite reconstruction; larger cb (capped by HR SMEM m*cb).

Built TSQR-HR for n=1024 B=60 (4 kernels gated to n==1024; n!=1024 byte-identical to parent d360cf57). CORRECT & VALIDATED: peeled-diagonal-sign Householder reconstruction on the explicit TSQR Q gives geqrf-exact (H,tau) for ALL conditioning (dense/rankdef/nearrank/clustered/mixed); 22 tests + 3 guards (diff_correctness 8-seed, invariance, offgrid) CLEAN; deterministic. Fixed a SMEM read-after-write race on the pivot row (cc[k]/qc[k] read by all threads then written by tid0 w/o barrier) that corrupted ~24/60 matrices nondeterministically at P>=3 under high CTA co-residency. Progress over 3 trials: nsys total GPU n=1024 107ms -> 55ms (explicit Q via compact-WY identity, killing the cb*cb reflector-replay barrier chain) -> 41ms/~38ms (single-barrier multi-value trailing update in local+tree). Benchmark geomean 13510 -> 11482 -> 10817 us. MEASURED VERDICT (contention-immune, n512 sentinel anchor + CUDA-event sweep): TSQR-HR is ~2.0-2.2x SLOWER than the parent single-CTA panel on n=1024 (clean-corrected parent n1024_dense ~21.4k us vs mine ~43.6k us), for ALL P swept 2..8 and lt 128/256 -- P barely moves it. WHY: the decomposition does ~2.4x the parent's flops (explicit Q + tree + HR + R-recon), the local row-split is latency-bound (cb=32 serial column steps UNCHANGED by the row split, so 4x more CTAs doesn't pay), and the per-panel tree (K2) + HR (K4) now dominate (52-60% of GPU) running ONE CTA per matrix on 60 CTAs (88 idle SMs) -- the same under-occupancy the brief flagged, shifted onto tree/HR. Both tree and HR have serial-over-cb dependencies that resist multi-CTA splitting (the per-column cross-CTA-sync wall the cooperative cluster hit). The first-panel-only TSQR variant ~= parent (19.3k vs 18.5k), confirming even the tallest panel doesn't win. OPEN DIRECTIONS (not exhausted): (1) make the tree+HR MULTI-CTA or WARP-SYNCHRONOUS (pack multiple matrices' tiny trees per CTA to fill the 88 idle SMs; HR's m*cb SMEM blocks packing, but HR could stream Y from global); (2) ELIMINATE the explicit-Q + HR for local blocks -- apply local+tree reflectors directly to the trailing matrix and HR only the small composite, cutting ~2.4x flops toward ~1x; (3) raise cb above 32 to cut the panel count (and tree+HR invocations) -- capped today by the HR kernel holding the full m*cb=1024*32 explicit Q in SMEM (128KB at cb=32; cb=64 overflows), so a streaming HR unlocks larger cb; (4) a warp-per-row-block local factor for P>=32 (hp<=32, no block barriers) paired with a deeper binary reduction tree. Committed trial 3 (92cb1f55, P=2 lt=256) is the measured best; profiles saved under profiles/2026-06-29-16-06-28/brief-39-trial-{1,2,3}-n1024-*.nsys-{rep,txt}.
